name: virlo
description: Connects the model to Virlo's TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels intelligence API — trend and sound discovery, creator and video lookups, content research agents, audience demographics, and long-term tracking.

interface.longDescription:
Virlo is short-form social intelligence for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

Ask what is trending right now and get momentum-ranked emerging trends, a curated daily digest, the top viral videos of the last ~48 hours, and the sounds and hashtags accelerating off a small base — ranked by weighted virality rather than raw view counts, so already-viral content does not crowd out what is actually breaking.

Go deeper on any creator or video: full profiles, outlier posts, posting cadence, engagement patterns, audience demographics and geography, and the sounds a creator reaches for. Look up a sound to see its usage history and the videos riding it, or analyze a single video in detail.

For real research, Virlo runs Content Research Agents. You describe a niche in one concrete sentence of intent; the agent expands that into keywords, collects across platforms, and returns videos, slideshows, ads, creator outliers with weighted virality scores, hashtag and sound momentum with lifecycle labels, benchmarks by follower tier, adjacent-topic affinity, and AI-generated themes and tactics. Run one once, or set it recurring on a daily, weekly, or monthly cadence to watch a niche over time. Reading agent results is always free, so you filter and re-slice collected data without paying again.

Tracking keeps creators and videos under long-term observation, capturing snapshots and reports on a recurring cycle.

Pricing is pay-as-you-go with no subscription: hashtag lookups $0.05/call, trends and video digests $0.25/call, content research agents $0.50/run, satellite analysis $0.50/call, tracking $0.25/cycle, with optional Data Intelligence add-ons for per-video AI analysis. All agent reads and tracking reads are free. Requires a Virlo API key from dev.virlo.ai.
capabilities: Surface emerging and breakout trends across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels
Rank viral videos from the last ~48 hours by weighted virality rather than raw views
Find trending and breakout sounds, and trace a sound's usage history and top videos
Look up any creator's profile, outlier posts, posting cadence, and engagement patterns
Read creator audience demographics and geography
Analyze an individual video in detail
Search hashtags and read per-hashtag performance and growth momentum
Run one-shot Content Research Agents over a stated research intent
Schedule recurring research agents on a daily, weekly, or monthly cadence
Read agent results free: videos, slideshows, ads, sounds, hashtags, outliers, benchmarks, affinity
Track creators and videos long-term with recurring snapshots and reports
Check credit balance and job status before and during paid research runs
